interactive_product_preview_architecture.description: Centerpiece synthetic data visualization simulating real CPGist intelligence suite. All charts, tables, and KPI metrics update synchronously on filter change.

ai_analyst_static_presets.question: What is driving the recent unit velocity surge in Target vs. Kroger?
ai_analyst_static_presets.verified_metrics: Target velocity grew +24.6% in L4W with an incremental promotional lift of +38% during the feature & display event in W7.
ai_analyst_static_presets.calculated_comparison: Target's unit sales per store per week (SPW) reached 24.6 vs. Kroger's 18.5 SPW, representing a +33% efficiency advantage.
ai_analyst_static_presets.possible_explanations: Endcap merchandising placement combined with a temporary $0.50 price promotion stimulated trial among cross-category shoppers.
ai_analyst_static_presets.limitations_and_missing_data: Syndicated POS scan data does not account for localized out-of-stock rates or specific regional digital coupon redemptions.

ai_analyst_static_presets.question: Are price increases eroding volume in natural channel retailers?
ai_analyst_static_presets.verified_metrics: Base price increased by +6.8% in Whole Foods and Sprouts over L12W. Total dollar sales rose +13.2% while units declined -1.4%.
ai_analyst_static_presets.calculated_comparison: Price elasticity calculated at -0.42, indicating inelastic consumer demand with net positive revenue expansion.
ai_analyst_static_presets.possible_explanations: Premium brand equity and high consumer loyalty in clean-ingredient categories insulate against moderate price adjustments.
ai_analyst_static_presets.limitations_and_missing_data: Competitor promotional calendars during W4-W6 were not fully captured in the syndicated dataset.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Restrained, crisp, professional (150ms-250ms). Zero bouncing, zero distracting floating blobs. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover_rules: All cards apply subtle transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease. Hover lifts cards by -2px with shadow-md.
motion_and_interactions.tab_transitions: Animate Presence with subtle fade-in (opacity 0 -> 1, duration 0.15s).

accessibility_requirements.landmarks: header, main, nav, section with aria-labelledby, footer
accessibility_requirements.contrast: All text strictly passes >= 4.5:1 against its declared surface
accessibility_requirements.chart_alternatives: Every Recharts graph provides an accessible aria-label and an expandable raw data table view for screen readers
accessibility_requirements.test_attributes: All interactive inputs, buttons, filters, modal triggers, and tabs MUST include role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Configure index.css with exact hex tokens (#101A36, #1E2761, #CADCFC, #F7F9FC, #667085) and import @fontsource-variable/inter.
2. Place the user's provided logo (orange/purple badge) in public/assets/cpgist-logo.png or reference the provided CDN URL, rendering with crisp chrome.
3. Build all 12 specified routes in App.tsx (Home, Platform, Solutions, How It Works, About, Contact, SignIn, Privacy, Terms, Refund Policy, Cookies, Data Deletion).
4. Build the rich InteractiveProductPreview centerpiece on Home with working filters (Brand, Retailer, Time Period) and synchronized synthetic metrics and charts.
5. Wire Contact / Demo form and Data Deletion form to FastAPI endpoints backed by MongoDB motor client with thorough Pydantic validation.
6. Build the honest Sign In page (/signin) with show/hide password, client validation, and clear feedback stating auth service connection status.
7. Implement CookieConsentBanner with customizable preferences and persistent footer link 'Cookie Settings'.
8. Ensure every button and input has data-testid attributes for automated testing.
